title: Call for Research Proposals: Potato Industry Sustainability and Innovation (South Africa)
desc: Deadline: 21-Sep-2026 Potatoes South Africa is inviting researchers to submit proposals for research that strengthens the sustainability, innovation, and competitiveness of South Africa’s potato industry. Priority areas include climate adaptation, precision agriculture, irrigation, nutrition, crop protection, soil health, and alternative plant protection strategies, with funding for approved projects expected to become available from 1 July
